# Milestone 6 (part): transfer-error decomposition (generated by summarise.py)

241 cells (source->target pair x item) over 20 pairs. Errors: absolute error of the target's weighted share, points. Intervals: pair-cluster bootstrap 95%, 2000 draws.

| estimator | all | generation | ethnicity | tradition | period | vs E0 [95%] | closer than E0 |

E3 minus E2: +0.06 points [-0.31, +0.35].

## Decomposition b = A + B

- median |b| 4.08, mean 5.59 points
- median |A-hat| (covariate shift, label-free) 0.83 points; |A-hat| < |B-hat| in 77% of cells
- median |B-hat| (concept shift) 3.45 points
- median importance-weight effective sample fraction 0.33
- Spearman(|E3 - E0|, |b|) = 0.11 (p = 0.095, n = 241 cells, not independent)
- sign of the E3 correction matches the sign needed in 71% of cells
